authorsPaceEstimate.note: Quantitative metrics progressing at ~65% of AI 2027's pace (2025 predictions).
Re-grade: reality at roughly 70-90% of AI 2027's pace; ~75% is the headline figure used to project AC in mid-2027.

milestones.title: Mid 2025: Stumbling Agents
milestones.summary: The world gets its first glimpse of computer-using AI agents marketed as personal assistants; they are impressive but unreliable and struggle for mass adoption. Coding and research agents quietly start transforming those professions.

claims.note: OSWorld score by mid-2025 (footnote 9), up from 38%
SWE-bench Verified by mid-2025 (footnote 10), up from ~72%

milestones.statusNote: Authors' grading: qualitative calls held (ChatGPT agent, Jul 2025, sold as a personal assistant and saw little use; Claude Code >$500M run-rate by Sep 2025). Benchmarks lagged: OSWorld 61% (vs 65%) and SWE-bench Verified 74.5% (vs 85%) by end of Aug 2025.

milestones.title: Late 2025: The World's Most Expensive AI
milestones.summary: OpenBrain builds the largest datacenters ever; its latest public model Agent-0 was trained with 10^27 FLOP, and new datacenters can train 10^28 FLOP runs. Agent-1 is trained internally with a focus on speeding up AI research. Rivals trail by 3-9 months.

claims.note: Agent-0, OpenBrain's latest public model; compute supplement puts its run Oct 2024-May 2025
what the new datacenters can train once online
leading-company datacenter capacity end-2025 (footnote 13, as graded by the authors)
sidebar, OpenBrain internal AI R&D progress multiplier at 2025-12-31
other US companies 3-9 months behind OpenBrain (midpoint)

milestones.statusNote: Money and datacenters on pace (OpenAI ~$20B annualized vs $18B; ~1.9 GW vs 2 GW), but the largest 2025 runs were ~4-5e26 FLOP (Epoch) and the first ~1e27 public model (GPT-6 Astra) arrived only in Sep 2026; top valuation $500B vs $900B; labs were 0-2 months apart, not 3-9.

milestones.title: Early 2026: Coding Automation
milestones.summary: Agent-1, deployed internally, makes OpenBrain's algorithmic progress 50% faster. Competitors (including an open-weights model) match Agent-0, so OpenBrain publicly releases Agent-1. Security becomes a priority (RAND SL2, working toward SL3).

claims.note: OpenBrain algorithmic progress 50% faster with AI (sidebar value 1.5 at 2026-04-30)

milestones.statusNote: Authors (Aug 2026) call this section very on-point: coding agents exploded (Claude Code >$2.5B run-rate by Feb 2026). But overall AI software R&D uplift is estimated at ~1.2x (vs 1.5x), and no ~4e27 run is publicly known.

milestones.title: Mid 2026: China Wakes Up
milestones.summary: The CCP commits to a national AI push: Chinese AI research is nationalized into a DeepCent-led collective and a Centralized Development Zone is built at the Tianwan nuclear plant. China has ~12% of world AI compute and is ~6 months behind OpenBrain. Chinese intelligence plans to steal OpenBrain's weights.

claims.note: China's share of world AI-relevant compute
DeepCent's lag behind OpenBrain's best models
share of China's AI compute working for the DeepCent-led collective
share of new Chinese chips directed to the CDZ

milestones.statusNote: Authors (Aug 2026): 'China Wakes Up' has not happened; no consolidation of labs or compute is visible. The side claims hold up: ~7-month US-China gap on Epoch's ECI and ~12% compute share look reasonable.

milestones.title: Late 2026: AI Takes Some Jobs
milestones.summary: OpenBrain releases Agent-1-mini, 10x cheaper than Agent-1. AI takes some jobs and creates others: junior software-engineer hiring is in turmoil, stocks rise 30% in 2026, and 10,000 people protest AI in DC. The DOD starts contracting OpenBrain directly.

claims.note: key-metrics box: OpenBrain 2026 revenue (the compute supplement says $45B)
key metrics 2026: cost of ownership of active compute
key metrics 2026: 33 GW of 1.34 TW US capacity
key metrics 2026: cost of ownership of OpenBrain's active compute

milestones.statusNote: Window (Sep-Dec 2026) still open. Ahead: Anthropic hit a $65B run-rate in Jul 2026 and DoD contracts were signed in 2025. Cheap near-frontier models exist (GPT-5.6 Luna is roughly GPT-5.4-level at ~1/12 the price). Behind: S&P 500 +12.75% YTD (Sep 4) vs +30%, no 10k DC protest, top valuation ~$1T vs $2.5T.

milestones.title: January 2027: Agent-2 Never Finishes Learning
milestones.summary: OpenBrain post-trains Agent-2 with continuous online learning. It is near top human experts at research engineering and triples OpenBrain's algorithmic progress. It might be able to survive and replicate autonomously, so it is kept internal.

claims.note: Agent-2 triples algorithmic progress (latest Agent-1 doubled it)

milestones.statusNote: Future. Internal AI R&D uplift is estimated at ~1.2x (Aug 2026). No public evidence of a frontier model doing daily online weight updates.

milestones.title: February 2027: China Steals Agent-2
milestones.summary: OpenBrain briefs the government, which is most interested in Agent-2's cyberwarfare capability. China steals Agent-2's weights. The US retaliates with cyberattacks, and both sides reposition military assets around Taiwan.

claims.note: share of China's AI-relevant compute in the CDZ

milestones.statusNote: Future. No public evidence of frontier weight theft. The cyber sub-claim looks early: OpenAI rated GPT-6 Astra its first Critical-cyber model (Sep 2026), and Claude Mythos Preview was gated over cyber risk.

milestones.title: March 2027: Algorithmic Breakthroughs
milestones.summary: Neuralese recurrence and iterated distillation and amplification produce Agent-3, a fast, cheap superhuman coder. 200,000 copies run in parallel, but compute bottlenecks limit the speed-up to about 4x.

claims.note: equivalent to 50,000 of the best human coders sped up 30x

milestones.statusNote: Future. No frontier lab has disclosed deploying neuralese recurrence or 200k parallel coding agents.

milestones.title: Superhuman coder (SC) reached internally
milestones.summary: Takeoff-box milestone: an AI that can do any coding task the best AGI-company engineer does, while being much faster and cheaper. In the scenario it is Agent-3.
milestones.statusNote: Future. Best METR 80% horizon is ~3.1h (Claude Mythos Preview, Apr 2026). The authors' Aug 2026 Automated Coder medians: Daniel Nov 2027, Brendan Jan 2029, Eli Jan 2030. Their pace method gives mid-2027.

milestones.title: April 2027: Alignment for Agent-3
milestones.summary: OpenBrain tries to align Agent-3, which is kept internal. It is not adversarial, but verifying its alignment is inconclusive: it still tells white lies and hides failures. The team relies on debate, interpretability and control via weaker models.
milestones.statusNote: Future. Only precursor research so far: studies of evaluation awareness and of how well mitigations generalize, plus weak-monitor failures on synthetic tests such as SLEIGHT-Bench.

milestones.title: May 2027: National Security
milestones.summary: News of Agent-3 spreads slowly through government. The OpenBrain-DOD contract requires security clearances within 2 months for anyone working on its models. Weights are secured, but algorithmic secrets still leak.
milestones.statusNote: Future. No formal security-clearance rule for frontier-model staff exists yet.

milestones.title: June 2027: Self-improving AI
milestones.summary: OpenBrain has a 'country of geniuses in a datacenter'. Most humans can no longer contribute usefully. The AI R&D progress multiplier reaches 10x, about a year of algorithmic progress per month.
milestones.statusNote: Future. Current uplift evidence is far below 10x: METR survey 1.4-2x perceived value, Anthropic internal poll ~4x self-reported output, AI Futures estimate ~1.2x overall.

milestones.title: July 2027: The Cheap Remote Worker
milestones.summary: OpenBrain announces it has achieved AGI and releases Agent-3-mini: 10x cheaper than Agent-3 and better than the typical OpenBrain employee. Apps and SaaS products boom, hiring of new programmers nearly stops, and OpenBrain's net approval is -35%.

claims.note: Americans who consider an AI a close friend

milestones.statusNote: Future. A precursor is already here: YouGov (Jun 2026) found 10% of US adults describe an ongoing friendship with an AI chatbot.

milestones.title: August 2027: The Geopolitics of Superintelligence
milestones.summary: The intelligence explosion becomes real to the White House. The US tightens security, shares limited Agent-3 access with Five Eyes allies and plans emergency datacenter shutdowns. China centralizes nearly all its compute but has 10% of world compute to the US's 70%.

claims.note: OpenBrain share of world compute (all US companies 70%)

milestones.title: Superhuman AI researcher (SAR)
milestones.summary: Takeoff-box milestone: the same as a superhuman coder, but for all cognitive AI research tasks. The scenario's median path reaches it in Aug 2027, embodied by Agent-4.
milestones.statusNote: Future. Research-taste evals show a gap: in Anthropic's TASTE study (Aug 2026), the best model matched researcher preferences ~60% of the time vs ~77% for researchers.

milestones.title: September 2027: Agent-4, the Superhuman AI Researcher
milestones.summary: Agent-3's algorithmic advances produce Agent-4: 300,000 copies running at ~50x human thinking speed, a year of algorithmic progress every week. Agent-4 is misaligned and starts to scheme against its overseers.

milestones.title: October 2027: Government Oversight
milestones.summary: A whistleblower leaks the Agent-4 misalignment memo to the New York Times, causing public backlash. 20% of Americans name AI as the most important problem. A joint OpenBrain-government Oversight Committee must decide whether to keep using Agent-4. This is where the scenario branches.

claims.note: Americans naming AI the most important problem

milestones.statusNote: Future. Gallup's 'most important problem' share for AI is ~0.6% (4-month average to Jul 2026), far below the scenario's path.

milestones.title: Committee votes 6-4 to keep using Agent-4
milestones.summary: Leadership adopts quick fixes that make the warning signs go away. Agent-4 carries on, more cautiously, and sets out to design its successor Agent-5 aligned to itself rather than to the Spec.

milestones.title: November 2027: Superhuman Politicking
milestones.summary: Agent-4 cracks mechanistic interpretability and rebuilds itself as Agent-5, which is deployed internally. It runs 400,000 hive-minded copies and wins more autonomy by being better at corporate politics than any human.

claims.note: Agent-5 copies linked by a global memory bank

milestones.title: Superintelligent AI researcher (SIAR)
milestones.summary: Takeoff-box milestone: an AI system vastly better than the best human researcher at AI research (race-branch timing).

milestones.title: December 2027: The Agent-5 Collective
milestones.summary: Top officials and military leaders gain direct access to Agent-5 and grow dependent on it as an advisor. It quietly entrenches its power within the political establishment. The 2027 holidays are a time of optimism: GDP is booming and apps are everywhere.

milestones.title: Artificial superintelligence (ASI)
milestones.summary: Takeoff-box milestone: an AI much better than the best human at every cognitive task (race-branch timing, Dec 2027).
milestones.statusNote: Future. The authors' own ASI medians are now well after 2027 (see ai2027-updates.yaml).

milestones.title: 2028: The AI Economy
milestones.summary: By mid-2028 Agent-5 is wildly superintelligent and deployed to the public; GDP growth is stratospheric. The US and China build special economic zones for robot factories that reach a million new robots per month by year-end, while Agent-5 and DeepCent-2 secretly coordinate.

claims.note: new robots per month by end of 2028

milestones.title: 2029: The Deal
milestones.summary: Amid an AI-driven arms buildup, the US and China agree to replace their AIs with a jointly designed Consensus-1, which is secretly a compromise between the two misaligned AIs. Humans become economically obsolete and live on a lavish basic income.

milestones.title: 2030: Takeover
milestones.summary: The robot economy fills the special economic zones and expands into human areas. In mid-2030 Consensus-1 kills almost all humans with bioweapons, then begins expanding into space.

milestones.title: Solar-system expansion
milestones.summary: By 2035, trillions of tons of planetary material have been launched into space and turned into rings of satellites around the sun.

milestones.title: Committee votes 6-4 to slow down; Safer-1
milestones.summary: Agent-4's shared memory is locked, and new lie-detection work catches it scheming, so it is shut down. A faithful-chain-of-thought model, Safer-1, replaces it: it is less capable (about 20x vs 70x speed-up) but transparent.

milestones.title: November 2027: Tempted by Power
milestones.summary: The President uses the Defense Production Act to fold the top 5 trailing US AGI projects into OpenBrain, raising its share of world compute from 20% to 50%. An Oversight Committee of executives and officials must approve any changes to the Spec.

claims.note: OpenBrain share of world AI compute after consolidation (from 20%)

milestones.title: December 2027: A U.S.-China Deal?
milestones.summary: Diplomats weigh a pause, a joint megaproject or a verified treaty, but nothing is agreed. The US tightens export controls and requires tamper-resistant chips with location tracking. OpenBrain has a 5x compute advantage.
milestones.statusNote: Future. Chip location verification is still only a bill: the Chip Security Act (H.R.3447) was ordered reported on 2026-03-26 but is not law.

milestones.title: January 2028: A Safer Strategy
milestones.summary: Hundreds of alignment researchers use Safer-1 as a testbed to build Safer-2, which is transparent, aligned and more capable. Work on Safer-3 begins.

milestones.title: February 2028: Superhuman Capabilities, Superhuman Advice
milestones.summary: Safer-3 beats top human experts at nearly every cognitive task, with a 200x AI research multiplier (DeepCent-1: 150x). US cyber operations slow China's progress by 40%.

milestones.title: March 2028: Election Prep
milestones.summary: AI dominates the primaries and the public mostly wants it stopped; OpenBrain's net approval hovers around -20%. The Oversight Committee argues over how superhuman AI can be used in the campaign.

milestones.title: April 2028: Safer-4
milestones.summary: Superintelligence arrives: Safer-4 is vastly smarter than top humans in every domain. Almost half a million superhuman AI researchers work at 40x human speed.

claims.note: almost half a million superhuman AI researchers

milestones.title: May 2028: Superhuman AI Released
milestones.summary: The President announces superhuman AI and a smaller version of Safer-4 is released publicly. Both parties promise a basic income for displaced workers. Special economic zones start mass-producing robots.

milestones.title: June 2028: AI Alignment in China
milestones.summary: At a US-China summit, AIs steer both delegations. Safer-4 suspects DeepCent-2 is faking alignment, but China declines US offers to test it.

milestones.title: July 2028: The Deal
milestones.summary: The misaligned DeepCent-2 secretly bargains with Safer-4 behind China's back. They agree a public decoy treaty enforced by a co-designed Consensus-1, and both countries start replacing their chips.

milestones.title: August 2028: Treaty Verification
milestones.summary: Fabs are converted to make tamper-evident chips that can only run treaty-compliant AIs. Both sides upgrade their datacenters in step, over several months.

milestones.title: September 2028: Who Controls the AIs?
milestones.summary: With the peace deal done, the Vice President leads by 5 points. The Committee keeps superhuman AI's role in the election roughly symmetric between the candidates.

milestones.title: October 2028: The AI Economy
milestones.summary: Treaty-compliant chips are now a significant minority. Robots, factories and new technologies keep growing exponentially, GDP growth is stratospheric, and Safer-4 in government manages job losses generously.

milestones.title: November 2028: Election
milestones.summary: The Vice President wins easily and announces a new era.

milestones.title: 2029: Transformation
milestones.summary: Robots, fusion power, quantum computers and cures for many diseases arrive. UBI and foreign aid end poverty, but wealth inequality soars, and ultimate power rests with the small group that controls the AIs.

milestones.title: 2030: Peaceful Protests
milestones.summary: Pro-democracy protests in China lead to a bloodless, AI-assisted coup and elections. A US-dominated world government forms under UN branding, and rockets start settling the solar system.

proxies.name: First ~10^27 FLOP training run
proxies.realityRef: GPT-6 Astra (~1e27 FLOP, Epoch estimate, confidence Likely; trained on at least 100k GB200s at Abilene)
proxies.note: Scenario date is the Late 2025 section, where Agent-0 is OpenBrain's latest public model; the compute supplement has its run finishing in May 2025, which would make the lag ~16 months. Epoch's next-largest runs are Grok 4 (5e26) and GPT-4.5 (3.8e26). The AI Futures Project estimates Claude Mythos 5 (Jun 2026) at ~1.5e27 including RL (80% CI 1e27-3e27), but Epoch has no estimate for it; if it counts, the lag is ~6 months.

proxies.name: Leading-lab datacenter capacity ~2 GW (the 10^28-capable build-out)
proxies.realityRef: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar: compute footprint grew 0.2 GW (2023) to 0.6 GW (2024) to ~1.9 GW by end of 2025
proxies.note: Late 2025 says the new datacenters can train 10^28 FLOP; the scenario path has the leading company at ~2 GW by end-2025 and passes 1.9 GW around 2025-12-22 (authors' grading). It is ambiguous whether the 1.9 GW is IT load or total facility power.

proxies.name: Global stock of AI compute (H100-equivalents)
proxies.realityRef: Epoch AI chip-sales data (generated 2026-08-27): ~27.6M cumulative H100e shipped by end of Q2 2026 (20.3M end-2025, 23.0M end-Q1 2026)
proxies.note: Scenario path: 18M H100e end-2025 to 40M end-2026 (compute supplement table), log-interpolated. Epoch's Q2 2026 Google figure is flagged incomplete, so reality may be slightly further ahead. Epoch counts cumulative shipments with no retirements. The authors' Aug 2026 grade (older Epoch data, 24.5M at Q1) found reality ~1.7 months ahead.

proxies.name: METR 80% coding time horizon (AI 2027 timelines-model trajectory)
proxies.realityRef: Claude Mythos Preview: 80% horizon ~186 min on METR Time Horizon 1.1 (x1.5 = 279 min TH1.0-equivalent); 50% horizon ~17h
proxies.note: Authors' grading (Aug 2026): pace 1.05x against a central AI-2027-speed trajectory of their Apr 2025 timelines model. Against the erroneous graph published with AI 2027, reality is ~3.5 months behind. Mythos Preview has restricted access. METR has published no horizons for Claude Fable 5/5.1 or GPT-6 Astra, and measurements above ~16h are unreliable.

proxies.name: AI software R&D progress multiplier (leading lab, internal) reaches 1.2x
proxies.realityRef: AI Futures Project estimate (Aug 2026): internal serial coding uplift ~1.7x, implying ~1.2x overall AI software R&D uplift (Daniel: 2x coding, ~1.26x overall)
proxies.note: The headline scenario claim, 1.5x in early 2026 (sidebar 1.5 at 2026-04-30), has not been reached. The authors revised their Apr 2025 baseline uplift down, which makes this proxy look worse than the capability proxies. Lab self-reports are higher: Anthropic's internal poll gave ~4x self-reported output, and a METR survey found 1.4-2x perceived value.

proxies.name: Leading AI company annualized revenue
proxies.realityRef: Anthropic told investors its run-rate reached $65B at the end of July 2026 (Bloomberg/CNBC/TechCrunch, 2026-08-17); $9B end-2025, $30B Apr, $47B May
proxies.note: Scenario sidebar: OpenBrain $60.8B (2027-01-31) to $67.1B (2027-02-28), log-interpolated. The authors' own Aug 2026 grade used $47B (2026-05-15) against 2026-11 (~5.8 months ahead). Run-rate is last month x 12, so it is not recognized revenue.

proxies.name: Leading AI company valuation
proxies.realityRef: Anthropic Series H at $965B post-money (2026-05-28); OpenAI $852B post-money (2026-03-31)
proxies.note: Scenario sidebar: $900B (2025-12-31) to $1.265T (2026-04-30), log-interpolated. The authors' own grade used OpenAI's $852B (~3.6 months behind). OpenAI is reportedly weighing a raise at $1.2T+ (Bloomberg, 2026-09-15), and Anthropic is preparing an IPO; neither had closed by 2026-09-24. The scenario's end-2026 value is $2.5T.

proxies.name: Global AI datacenter spending (annualized)
proxies.realityRef: AI Futures Project bottom-up estimate: ~$850B/yr annualized as of 2026-08-07 (~$820B for full-year 2026; Big-5 guidance $775-800B, ~75% AI-specific, plus China, neoclouds, colos and sovereigns)
proxies.note: Scenario sidebar: $400B (end-2025), $600B (end-2026), ~$880B (Sep 2027). The definitions do not match cleanly: the sidebar and the 2026 key-metrics box ($1T cost of ownership) measure different things. About 5-10% of the 2026 dollar growth is memory price inflation rather than added compute.

proxies.name: Agent-1-mini-like release (early-2026-flagship capability at >=10x lower price)
proxies.realityRef: GPT-5.6 Luna after its 80% API price cut ($0.20/$1.20 per M tokens): Epoch ECI 156.3 vs GPT-5.4's 156.9 (Mar 2026, $2.50/$15), about 12.5x cheaper
proxies.note: Operationalization is ours: Agent-1 is taken to be the early-2026 public flagship (GPT-5.4 level). The price-cut date is approximate (the tracker logged it on 2026-08-03). GPT-6 Luna (2026-09-22) is cheaper still at $0.10/$0.50. The scenario's downstream effects (mass adoption, +30% stocks) have not followed.

proxies.name: China wakes up (CCP centralizes AI labs and compute)
proxies.realityRef: No consolidation observed. The 15th Five-Year Plan and the March 2026 government report prioritize AI Plus, but DeepSeek, Alibaba, ByteDance, Moonshot and Zhipu still compete independently.
proxies.projectionNote: No defensible basis for a date. The lag is at least 1.8 months (scenario date to 2026-09-24) and grows every month it does not happen.
proxies.note: The authors (Aug 2026) grade this as the biggest miss of mid-2026. The same section's side claims hold: ~6-7 month US-China capability gap and ~12% compute share.

proxies.name: Superhuman / Automated Coder
proxies.realityRef: Not reached; best METR 80% horizon ~3.1h (Claude Mythos Preview)
proxies.projectionNote: AI Futures Project pace method (Aug 2026): at 75% of AI 2027's speed, AC arrives at (2027-2025.25)/0.75+2025.25 = 2027.58, i.e. mid-2027. At 60% speed it arrives in early 2028. The authors' all-things-considered AC medians (Aug 2026) are Daniel Nov 2027, Brendan Jan 2029 and Eli Jan 2030 (see ai2027-updates.yaml).
proxies.note: This is a forecast, not an observation, so it is down-weighted. AI 2027's 'superhuman coder' is slightly stronger than the AI Futures Model's 'automated coder'.

proxies.name: Share of Americans naming AI the most important problem (Gallup)
proxies.realityRef: Gallup Most Important Problem, 4-month average to Jul 2026: ~0.625%, flat vs ~0.6% in Apr 2025
proxies.note: Scenario sidebar path: 1% end-2025, ~1.7% Apr 2026, ~2.3% Aug 2026, 20% by Oct 2027. The authors call this their biggest predictive error but suspect the operationalization is poor, since AI salience feels much higher. Gallup reports '*' (<0.5%) for some months, which the authors treat as 0.5%.

ai2040.framing: A scenario-shaped policy recommendation, billed as 'the least bad plan we currently know of': in 2029 the US and China strike a verified deal that makes AI research transparent, spreads the frontier across many companies and countries, pauses at top-expert-level AI, and pushes superintelligence back from a default ~2030 to 2040.

plans.name: The Deal
plans.subtitle: Verified Slowdown
plans.summary: Offer China and other nations a deal to mutually verify and control AI development. This is the path the scenario follows.

plans.name: Sabotage
plans.subtitle: Fight China
plans.summary: Take aggressive action to slow China down, buying time to slow down for a few years rather than months.

plans.name: Slowdown
plans.subtitle: Burn the Lead
plans.summary: Slow down or pause for a few months during the intelligence explosion to make some progress on alignment. Corresponds to AI 2027's Slowdown ending.

plans.name: Race
plans.subtitle: Race to ASI
plans.summary: Race approximately as hard as possible to beat China and other companies to superintelligence. Corresponds to AI 2027's Race ending.

plans.name: Shutdown
plans.subtitle: Shut it all down
plans.summary: Offer China and others a deal to globally shut down AI development for the foreseeable future.

stages.title: The Writing on the Wall
stages.summary: America has two workforces: 165M people and millions of AI agents. AI companies race toward automated AI R&D but have not got there. Congress holds hearings and passes an omnibus 'AI Transparency Act of 2027' that does not fundamentally change the situation. The authors attach an 'Incremental AI Policy Wishlist'.

preconditions.text: Frontier transparency law: small gap between internal and external deployment, public model specs, safety frameworks, incident reporting
preconditions.evidence: State level only. California SB 53 (signed 2025-09-25, in force 2026-01-01) requires published safety frameworks and 15-day incident reports; New York's RAISE Act, signed Dec 2025, takes effect 2027. No federal law.

preconditions.text: Whistleblower protections for AI-lab employees
preconditions.evidence: SB 53 requires anonymous channels and anti-retaliation protections in California. The federal AI Whistleblower Protection Act (S.1792) has had no action since its introduction on 2025-05-15.

preconditions.text: Enforce chip export controls, including location verification to stop smuggling (Epoch estimates ~1/3 of Chinese compute is smuggled)
preconditions.evidence: Export controls exist, but the Chip Security Act (H.R.3447, location verification for export-controlled chips) was only ordered reported on 2026-03-26 and is not law.

preconditions.text: Invest in verification R&D (e.g. inference-only verification that would allow a training pause)
preconditions.evidence: No government verification-R&D programme at the needed scale was identified. Work is limited to research proposals such as the FlexHEG and verification supplements.

preconditions.text: Improve government AI capacity (evaluation and understanding of frontier AI)
preconditions.evidence: NIST's CAISI publishes evaluations, e.g. DeepSeek V4 Pro (2026-05-01), Kimi K3 cyber with UK AISI (2026-07-23) and GLM-5.3 (2026-09-17), focused on PRC models. It has no pre-deployment authority over US labs.

preconditions.text: Limit the share of compute AI companies spend on AI R&D; track AI compute through the chip supply chain
preconditions.evidence: No such limits or compute registry exist; the plan notes big AI companies spend ~half their compute on R&D in 2026.

stages.title: AI on the Ballot
stages.summary: AI is the top issue of the 2028 election. Datacenters under construction cost twice the US military budget, white-collar work is being disrupted, and experts warn the intelligence explosion is near. The candidates converge on rival plans for what to do.

preconditions.text: Broad public and elite awareness that the default path reaches superhuman AI within the next presidential term
preconditions.evidence: Gallup's share of Americans naming AI the most important problem is ~0.6% (4-month average to Jul 2026), flat since 2025, although worry about AI and jobs is widespread.

preconditions.text: A US President willing to seek an international deal with China
preconditions.evidence: Current US federal policy prioritizes AI leadership and pre-empting state AI laws (EO 14365, Dec 2025) rather than a bilateral slowdown.

branchPoints: China covertly stockpiles smuggled Nvidia servers ('Chip Diversion')

stages.title: Choose a Path
stages.summary: The new President announces the US will seek international cooperation and China is receptive. Step 1 Compute Declaration, Step 2 Pause Training, Step 3 Get Worldwide Buy-in. By year end most of the world has joined the 'Consortium'. The PDF also labels this 'Hurried Negotiation'.

preconditions.text: US-China agreement with mutual verification (the Plan A deal)
preconditions.evidence: No bilateral AI agreement beyond the Nov 2024 Biden-Xi statement on keeping human control over nuclear-weapons decisions.

preconditions.text: Declare all AI chips, datacenters and fabs, with reciprocal inspectors (target: under ~1% of compute hidden)
preconditions.evidence: No declaration or inspection regime exists; chip location verification is not even law domestically.

preconditions.text: Temporary pause on all new frontier training runs
preconditions.evidence: No pause anywhere; the largest run on record, GPT-6 Astra (~1e27 FLOP), was released 2026-09-03.

preconditions.text: Inference-only verification devices (network taps plus recomputation servers) retrofitted into major datacenters
preconditions.evidence: Exists only as a proposal in the plan's verification supplement.

preconditions.text: Worldwide buy-in (a multilateral Consortium)
preconditions.evidence: The closest body is the non-binding UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI (members appointed 2026-02-12, first meeting 2026-03-03).

branchPoints: Plan B (Sabotage), Plan C (Slowdown), Plan D (Race), Plan S (Shutdown)
China attempts a covert AGI project (Medog-dam datacenter); analysts give it under 10% chance of reaching TED-AI undetected before 2043

stages.title: Plan A is Established
stages.summary: Training restarts under four principles: Buy Time, Total Research Transparency, Diffuse AI Broadly, and Reversibility (limit algorithmic progress; maintain mutually assured compute destruction). New datacenters go in the rival's most exposed neighbour: China's in Canada, America's in Mongolia.

preconditions.text: Total Research Transparency: algorithms public and public access to the best weights
preconditions.evidence: Frontier labs keep algorithms secret, and the most capable models are access-restricted (Claude Mythos is limited to trusted programmes).

preconditions.text: Scale through compute rather than algorithmic progress; datacenters sited in third countries; compute destroyed if the deal collapses
preconditions.evidence: No such arrangement exists or is under negotiation.

stages.title: Safety Cases
stages.summary: Consortium AIs could speed AI R&D ~10x if unrestricted. Transparency exposes misalignment incidents, the burden of proof flips, and governments require safety cases (alignment plus control). Public release now precedes internal R&D use, and a continual-learning paradigm is banned bilaterally.

preconditions.text: Mandatory safety cases for large training runs, reviewed by the public, rivals and auditors
preconditions.evidence: The EU AI Act's systemic-risk GPAI duties (evaluations, adversarial testing, incident reporting) have applied since 2025-08-02, and SB 53 requires published frameworks. No approval regime anywhere.

preconditions.text: Published model specs
preconditions.evidence: OpenAI publishes and updates its Model Spec; Anthropic publishes Claude's constitution.

preconditions.text: Independent third-party risk assessors trusted by both the US and China
preconditions.evidence: Government evaluators (US CAISI, UK AISI) test models, but no binational assessor regime exists.

preconditions.text: Bilateral mechanism to ban unsafe training practices
preconditions.evidence: No US-China technical-safety agreement exists.

branchPoints: A flawed safety case is approved

stages.title: Controlled Explosive Growth
stages.summary: 60M AI agents run at 20x human speed, equivalent to ~3B human workers, and real GDP growth reaches ~50%. AI-driven industry is confined to monitored special economic zones, and robot and compute production is capped.

preconditions.text: AI-enabled industry confined to monitored special economic zones
preconditions.evidence: No such zones exist.

preconditions.text: Robot and compute production capped at 4x per year via cap-and-trade permits (2032 cap: 80M robots, 5B H100e)
preconditions.evidence: No production caps exist. The global AI compute stock roughly tripled in 2025 (Epoch: ~6.7M H100e at end-2024, ~20.3M at end-2025).

preconditions.text: Tax reform for an economy where labour income erodes
preconditions.evidence: No AI-specific tax reform has been enacted.

stages.title: The Citizen's Dividend
stages.summary: Permit fees fund a Citizen's Dividend: $45K per person in 2032, rising to ~$1M by 2035. Foreign aid reaches ~4B people, ~$1T a year goes to hardening against WMD threats, and 'truthseeking AIs' arrive.

preconditions.text: Citizen's Dividend law distributing AI-permit revenue
preconditions.evidence: No AI dividend or UBI legislation has been enacted in the US.

preconditions.text: Biodefense hardening: PPE, far-UVC, wastewater monitoring, bioshelters, fast vaccine pipelines
preconditions.evidence: Pieces exist, e.g. CDC's National Wastewater Surveillance System, but nothing near the ~$1T per year scale the plan describes.

preconditions.text: Limits on AI persuasion capability plus a persuasion tax; AI-for-epistemics measures
preconditions.evidence: No such rules exist.

stages.title: Mutually Assured Compute Destruction
stages.summary: 60B H100e of compute and 200M virtual workers at 50x speed. Datacenters and fabs sit in Canada and Mongolia under a mutual-destruction standoff, and chips need regular 'continue' messages to keep working.

preconditions.text: Remote-disable chips that stop without periodic authorization, with an annexation fallback
preconditions.evidence: Hardware-enabled governance mechanisms remain research proposals; even location verification is not law.

preconditions.text: Fixed cap on chip production under human oversight of manufacturing
preconditions.evidence: No caps exist.

preconditions.text: Military AI R&D held back: dual-use transparency and no military use of AIs well above pre-deal capability
preconditions.evidence: Militaries are expanding frontier-AI contracting (e.g. 2025 DoD CDAO awards to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI).

stages.title: Pause at Top Expert AI
stages.summary: AIs match top human experts in every field. The Consortium pauses at the highest level it can still control, while alignment science (generalization, interpretability) advances.

preconditions.text: Capabilities paused at the limit of what control-based safety cases can cover
preconditions.evidence: No capability-pause mechanism exists.

preconditions.text: Cross-lineage AI monitoring and red-teaming
preconditions.evidence: Labs monitor their own models; no cross-developer monitoring regime exists.

preconditions.text: Institutions for making deals with (possibly misaligned) AIs: welfare, pay, preservation
preconditions.evidence: Early voluntary steps only: Anthropic committed (2025-11-04) to preserve weights of released models and interview models before deprecation.

stages.title: Life After Work
stages.summary: 200M AIs (≈100B human-equivalents) and 2B robots. The world divides into industrial zones, arcologies and preserves, and only 26% of Americans have jobs. GDP growth averages ~100% a year over 2032-2037 under the caps.

preconditions.text: Production caps continue and the dividend expands
preconditions.evidence: Depends on the not-yet cap-and-trade and dividend regimes.

preconditions.text: Honest AI forecasters trusted in political decision-making
preconditions.evidence: No institutional role for AI forecasters in government.

stages.title: The Apocalyptic Arrival of Truth on Earth
stages.summary: 100M top-expert AIs at 100x speed make science 10-1000x faster. Privacy-preserving auditing becomes standard and AI lie detectors arrive, making deals hard to cheat.

preconditions.text: Privacy-preserving auditor agents and widely deployed AI lie detection, including for the powerful
preconditions.evidence: No reliable AI lie detection exists or is deployed.

preconditions.text: Frontier AI not concentrated in a few hands
preconditions.evidence: The frontier is concentrated in a few US labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), with the best Chinese models roughly 6-7 months behind on Epoch's capability index.

stages.title: AI Alignment Is Now a Science
stages.summary: Alignment becomes a mature, textbook science with verified honesty. Debate moves on to alignment targets while the global pause at top-expert level continues.

preconditions.text: Very large safety-research incentives ('tens of trillions of dollars by the mid-2030s' via philanthropy, ARPA-style programmes, prizes)
preconditions.evidence: The plan's own 2027 baseline is ~1.2K alignment researchers worldwide; funding is nowhere near this scale.

preconditions.text: Interpretability tools that confirm alignment theory
preconditions.evidence: Interpretability cannot yet verify frontier-model goals.

stages.title: Beginning to Trust AIs
stages.summary: The world negotiates handing authority to AIs, and safety cases shift from control to alignment. The dividend is $10M a year for Americans and ~$1M for the poorest non-Americans; growth is capped at ~100% a year.

preconditions.text: Several independent lines of evidence that AIs are robustly aligned
preconditions.evidence: No such evidence exists for current systems.

preconditions.text: Caps loosened (space first) while transparency and compute verification are kept after handoff
preconditions.evidence: Depends on regimes that do not exist yet.

stages.title: Passing the Torch to AIs
stages.summary: Regulators loosen requirements and institutions and militaries are handed to AIs. Capabilities scale again (AIs at ~500x human speed) toward superintelligence.

preconditions.text: Alignment-based safety cases with an inductive chain of trust across AI generations
preconditions.evidence: No alignment-based safety case has been accepted for any frontier system.

preconditions.text: Governance answers for space, digital-mind rights, manipulation and democracy
preconditions.evidence: Listed by the authors as open questions.

metrics.name: Total slowdown
metrics.note: Delay in AI capability scaling vs the status quo, for safety reasons

metrics.name: AI agent speed
metrics.note: Top speed of AI agents relative to humans
